presets.name: standard
presets.title: Standard
presets.description: The defaults used when no preset is named. They are conventional choices with the reason beside each, not the result of tuning on any dataset.

radius_arcmin.reason: Map vs catalog: each source is compared with the map averaged over a 10 arcmin disk. The radius sets the map scale being tested, so change it to the scale you want to test.

min_pixels.reason: Map vs catalog: a disk with fewer than 5 usable pixels gives a very noisy mean orientation, so that source is not used and is counted.

snr_min.reason: P/σP ≥ 3 is the usual detection threshold for a polarization angle: it keeps the angle error at or below about 9.5 degrees. It applies only when the P and σP columns are chosen; the filter is off otherwise.

sigma_floor_deg.reason: Map vs catalog: source weights are 1/max(σ, 1°)², so a very precisely measured source cannot dominate the weighted mean.

boot_samples.reason: Resamples for the 16th to 84th percentile range of AM: a count that is cheap to compute and gives a stable range; the seed is recorded.

n_shifts_catalog.reason: Map vs catalog: shifted copies of the source pattern drawn for the chance level. Each is cheap, so there are more than for two maps.

n_shifts_maps.reason: Map vs map: shifted copies of the second map drawn for the chance level. Each shift costs a pass over the whole map, so there are fewer than for a catalog.

min_shift_deg.reason: A shift shorter than 1 degree leaves the pattern nearly where it was, so it is not a chance arrangement; shorter offsets are redrawn.

keep_fraction.reason: A shift counts only if at least 90% of the real samples still have a usable value there; a shift that pushes more onto empty map is dropped, not redrawn.

seed.reason: Fixed so that the same inputs give the same numbers. The value has no meaning; change it to see how much the chance level depends on the draw.

bins.reason: Nine equal-width bins of |Δψ| over 0 to 90 degrees, 10 degrees each.

strata_bins.reason: With a third map: five equal-count bins, enough to show a trend while keeping many pixels in each bin.

presets.name: lmc-star-comparison
presets.title: LMC star comparison
presets.description: The settings of the group's LMC starlight-polarization comparison. Every value is the same as in the standard preset: that analysis keeps stars with P/σP of 3 or more, as the standard preset does, and it uses the same disk, weights, null and bootstrap. The preset exists so a result can say which analysis it follows and so the two can differ later without changing old results.

radius_arcmin.reason: Same as standard: a 10 arcmin disk around each star.

min_pixels.reason: Same as standard: a disk needs at least 5 usable pixels.

snr_min.reason: Stars with P/σP below 3 are left out of the LMC comparison; the standard preset has the same threshold.
